Container.Name: VynodeArr
Container.Overview: Manage Radarr-backed movies and Sonarr-backed television from one secure VynodeArr dashboard while each engine keeps its own database and settings. Includes library management, automatic and interactive searches, queues, history, wanted media, calendars, collections, discovery, poster overlays, backups, and guided service configuration.
Container.Description: VynodeArr is a unified, self-hosted movie and television library manager built for Unraid. The container includes installation-managed Radarr and Sonarr engines behind one VynodeArr gateway; their databases, settings, queues, logs, and persistent data remain isolated.First start: select separate movie and television shares, the completed-download share used by your download client, and a persistent appdata location. Open the Web UI and create the first administrator account. Indexers, download clients, discovery, notifications, Plex, Reeltrack, and other services are configured inside VynodeArr.Existing libraries are supported. Back up /config before upgrades or removal. Radarr and Sonarr remain GPLv3 software maintained by their respective contributors. VynodeArr code is licensed under Apache 2.0; full component versions, source links, and notices are included in the image.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: radarr sonarr movies television tv media manager library requests posters overlays
Container.Changes: 2.0.40: Added flexible movie and television library destinations under an optional main media mapping while retaining legacy paths. Root migrations now update and verify engine title and collection mappings. Improved Discover filters, automatic search recovery, trailers, overlays, lists, and mobile search.
Container.Requires: Requires an x86-64 Unraid server with Docker. Appdata, movie, television, and completed-download paths must be writable by nobody:users (99:100). The optional main media folder exposes one shared parent so its direct child folders can be assigned to the movie or television engine inside VynodeArr. Existing installations may temporarily keep /movies or /tv mapped to the same physical folder while migrating to /media; use the guarded path update in Storage Folders before removing the legacy mapping. The download-client remote path must match the path reported by that client so VynodeArr can translate it to /downloads.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the VynodeArr web interface and compatibility APIs.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent VynodeArr accounts, settings, backups, and isolated engine databases. Back up this folder before removal.

Config.Name: Main media folder (optional)
Config.Description: Recommended for multiple libraries beneath one parent share. Example host path: /mnt/user/media. VynodeArr scans only direct child folders such as /media/movies, /media/movies-4k, /media/tv, or /media/anime-tv and lets you assign each one to Movies or Television under Service Settings. Leave blank to use only the legacy /movies and /tv mappings.

Config.Name: Legacy movie library (optional)
Config.Description: Backward-compatible movie mapping for existing installations or a simple single-library setup. Leave blank when /media exposes this library as a child folder.

Config.Name: Legacy television library (optional)
Config.Description: Backward-compatible television mapping for existing installations or a simple single-library setup. Leave blank when /media exposes this library as a child folder.

Config.Name: Completed downloads
Config.Description: Completed-download share accessible to VynodeArr and your download client. Keep this container path as /downloads.

Config.Name: Download client remote path
Config.Description: Container path reported by the download client for completed files, for example /data/complete. VynodeArr maps it to /downloads.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for schedules and displayed dates, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: TMDB read token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for Discover during first start. It can be added or replaced later under Service Settings.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when every browser connection reaches VynodeArr through HTTPS.
